name: What are the first steps I should take before starting work on a historic property?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps I should take before starting work on a historic property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Begin with research into the property’s history and any applicable regulations, then commission a thorough condition assessment by professionals familiar with historic structures. From there, you can prioritize critical repairs, develop a phased plan, and coordinate early with local review boards or planning departments.
